reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isWeekendSkippedDaily windowing and parseRecurDate data instead of adding a parallel holiday path.

duplication.why: The skipped-day test is defined once in isSkippedDay and replaces every inline d.isWeekend filter; the two window-size heuristics (getWeekdayCycleLength in shared, getWeekendShiftDays in schedules/app.ts) are similar but separate.

placement.why: Rule helpers live in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend logic; the search-window helper stays local to schedules/app.ts, which is acceptable but splits the holiday window sizing across two modules.

scope.why: Only the weekend/holiday paths, the RecurConfig type and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Generalising the weekend solve to a step loop over isSkippedDay is clean, though holidays must be threaded as an extra argument at every call site rather than carried with the config.

one_place.where: isSkippedDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template
